text:
maya: Quick preflight heads-up — entering a quiet window for the release at 23:00 UTC. Please avoid non-blocking merges until we finalize. Need a version bump PR and a short changelog entry within the hour. CI green sweep will run in ~30m; flaky triage immediately after. :eyes:

omar: on it — pushing the bump PR now. cc @linh for changelog review.

linh: I can do the changelog. Do we have the final list of commits to summarize? Link or command?

maya: run `git log --oneline release-candidate..main` to gather commits. Add entries under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md, one-line bullets. Example format: 

```
- runtime: reduce batch window default to 25ms (improves tail latency)
- model: pin transformer v2 for inference perf
```

kevin: FYI CI history shows 5 flaky tests flagged yesterday — I'll include them in the triage list and run them during the green sweep.

ci-bot: Build started: job/release-green-sweep #4123 triggered by maya. Status: queued.

kevin: kicking off local smoke now, will paste failures here. If anything consistently fails >3 reruns, we treat as blocker.

maya: Agreed — if a test fails >=3 reruns consistently, tag as blocker and ping @release-captain. Cutoff is in ~2 hours; we should aim to have merges done with 45m buffer.

release-captain: Acknowledged — I'll be on standby for rollbacks. If we hit >2 blocking failures, plan is to delay cutoff by 1 hour and notify PMs and infra.

omar: Bump PR opened: https://git.company/p/r/1234 — updates version to 2.4.1 and includes a changelog stub. @linh PTAL.

linh: Reviewing now. Small phrasing nit on one entry, will push a follow-up commit to the PR.

kevin: Green sweep progress: 0 compile errors, 1 transient flake in integration/net, 3 slow tests flagged (timing flakiness). Re-ran integration/net x3 — all passes. Marking that one as non-blocker for cutoff.

maya: Nice work. Keep any late CI notes here. If nothing else, plan to merge bump + changelog at T+45m. Everyone please avoid any unrelated pushes until we land. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build update: job/release-green-sweep #4123 — running tests (40/200).

kevin: If we see slow-tests fail consistently, I can add a temporary tag to skip them in the release matrix and run a focused job post-cutoff. Will coordinate with infra.

release-captain: Good contingency. Also reminder: update release notes doc with the final PR link after merge, and set the rollout policy to canary for first 2 hours.

maya: Thanks team — I’ll monitor the sweep and merge when all green or after agreed mitigation. Post any blockers here immediately.
